structuralCandidate.rule: One reentrant execution core accepts explicit Snapshot, Plan, repositories, cancellation, clocks, and resource budgets; it owns no process-global project state.
A one-shot host is always supported for CI, offline use, recovery, and environments forbidding residency. It is a full capability path, not a degraded mode.
A resident host, if shipped, owns only explicitly scoped warm inventory journals, semantic universes, and derived indexes; those are invalidatable accelerators, never unrecorded evidence authority.
One-shot and resident hosts use the same storage transaction/CAS publication protocol. Resident presence cannot be required to prevent corruption.

Client/engine handshake carries protocol family+major, engine binary/provider identities, project identity, and supported features. Incompatibility causes controlled restart or one-shot fallback, never silent reuse.
Warm state has explicit invalidation roots, leases, memory budgets, eviction, and privacy teardown. No cache hit may bypass derivation identity or Coverage checks.

parityCorrection.rule: For deterministic producers with identical Snapshot, Plan, toolchain/environment, and exact Coverage, EvidenceDigest equality is Boolean and mandatory: every case matches, not an acceptable rate.
When wall-time budgets cause Coverage to differ, the test first reports a Coverage divergence. It must not call unequal digests a lifetime-semantic failure or claim parity from equal summary enums.
Parity corpus includes cold/warm transitions, config/dependency changes, journal loss, provider crash/restart, cache eviction, and concurrent writers.

reviewOfMeasurements.correction: Benchmark target Plan/workload classes, not incumbent fit/check-changed command names. Declare corpus shape, machine, toolchain, cache state, files read, facts required, and Coverage.
Report semantic-universe rebuild causes and percentage, not only latency.
No equality rate. Run a deterministic parity corpus with exact identity/Coverage preconditions and require zero mismatches.
Add crash/restart and incompatible-engine fallback while writers are active.
Measure idle and peak RSS, eviction effectiveness, and aggregate memory across multiple projects.

additionalMeasurements.metric: Concurrent one-shot/resident write, crash, recovery, and CAS/ledger linearizability stress
Staleness corpus for source, compiler config, lock/dependency, generated-file, and toolchain changes
Resident availability, startup/restart time, incompatible-version fallback success, and orphan cleanup
Multi-project fairness, idle/peak aggregate RSS, eviction latency, and source-derived-state teardown
Latency benefit by logical fact requirement class from C-1, including syntax-only, resolved-reference, and type-flow workloads
additionalMeasurements.blocks: claim that semantics makes residency load-bearing for the normal workload
